blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.
blocks.zh: 代码切换(CS)自动语音识别(ASR)仍然困难,因为真实的CS语音很少,合成语音不完全与之匹配. 我们调查合成CS演讲是否比普通的不断微调更有助于学习适应的初始化。 我们提议采用SyRA-CS,这是基于Reptile meta-learning的一对特定的合成-现实适应框架。 对于每种语言对称和预训模型,我们对相应的合成CS-FLEURS子集进行元训练,然后使用1小时的标签真实目标语句进行调适. 我们评价四个建筑设置:编码器-CTC,快讯-RNN-T,注意编码器-解码器(AED)和Speech-LLM. 实验覆盖了阿拉伯语、法语、德语和印地语英语,反对只进行合成转移,只进行真正的微调,持续微调。 SyRA-CS在所有16个模型-平面比较中改进了WER的连续微调,在16个模型中改进了CER的连续微调,XLS-R的相对宏观WER减少17.7%,其他三种模型减少5.3-5.8%。 这些收益掌握在经过测试的模型中,但结构、语言对称和衡量尺度的大小各不相同。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Code-switching (CS)—the alternation of two or more languages within a conversation or utterance—is a common phenomenon in multilingual communities, but presents additional challenges for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems. The challenge is both linguistic and data-centric: real CS corpora are expensive to collect and transcribe, and switching patterns vary with speaker community, accent, discourse function, topic, and orthographic convention. As a result, ASR models trained for one CS condition often degrade under another ( Sitaram et al., 2019 ; Lyu et al., 2010 ; Li and Fung, 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 代码转换(CS)——一种对话或言论中两种或两种以上语言的交替——是多语种社区的一个常见现象,但对自动语音识别系统提出了额外的挑战。 挑战既以语言,又以数据为中心:真正的CS公司很昂贵,可以收集和转录,而转换模式则因演讲者群体、口音、话语功能、话题和正体会而不同。 因此,接受过一个CS条件培训的ASR模型往往在另一个条件下降解(Sitaram等,2019;Lyu等,2010;Li和Fung,2012)。

blocks.en:
Synthetic CS speech offers an attractive way to cheaply expand supervision data ( Yan et al., 2025 ; Dhawan et al., 2023 ) , but synthetic speech does not perfectly match real speech. Synthetic utterances may have cleaner acoustics, less speaker and accent variability. Therefore, simply fine-tuning on synthetic CS speech may overfit to synthetic regularities instead of generalizing to real CS recognition.
An alternative approach is meta-learning: a method that trains a model to become adaptable , by repeatedly simulating small adaptation episodes and updating the parameters so that a few gradient steps on a new, data-scarce task lead to good performance ( Finn et al., 2017 ) . The output is not a final recognizer but an initialization from which fine-tuning on a small labeled set is fast and stable.
This paper asks a focused question: under a limited real data budget, can a meta-learned initialization from synthetic CS speech adapt better to real CS speech compared to standard training strategies? We use Reptile ( Nichol et al., 2018 ) because it is a first-order meta-learning algorithm that repeatedly simulates adaptation episodes and moves the initialization toward parameters that are easy to reach after a few gradient steps: our contribution is not a new meta-learning optimizer or a benchmark of all meta-learning algorithms (Section 4.1 ). Instead, we test whether a lightweight meta-initializer is useful for synthetic-to-real CS ASR under severe target scarcity.
We train one Reptile initialization for each combination of language pair and pretrained model. Our experiments cover four architectural settings: XLS-R 300M with a CTC prediction
head ( Babu et al., 2021 ) , Nemotron 3.5 with a
FastConformer–RNN-T architecture ( NVIDIA, 2026a ) ,
Whisper-small with an attention encoder–decoder architecture ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , and Nemotron-Labs-Audex-2B as a Speech-LLM ( NVIDIA, 2026b ) . Within each model–pair combination, the training regimes start from
the same pretrained checkpoint and use the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset. Methods requiring real-domain adaptation use the same one-hour labeled target subset.
Hindi-English is evaluated on MUCS 2021 ( Diwan et al., 2021 ) , while Arabic-English, French-English,
and German-English are evaluated on SwitchLingua ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . This design evaluates within-pair synthetic-to-real adaptation across different pretrained ASR systems; it does not learn a shared multilingual
meta-initialization.
Our contributions are: • We formulate pair-specific synthetic-to-real code-switched ASR as a data-efficient meta-learning problem, using synthetic speech to learn an initialization for adaptation with one hour of labeled real target speech • We investigate Reptile across four architectural settings: Encoder–CTC, FastConformer–RNN-T, attention encoder–decoder, and Speech-LLM, using comparisons
against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning within each pretrained model. • We characterize the code-switching profile of each real target set (switching ratio) and assess the robustness of the gains to
the two smallest evaluation sets.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Multilingual self-supervised
blocks.zh: 2.1 多语种自我监督

blocks.en: Self-supervised speech learning has become the dominant paradigm for low-resource ASR. Baevski et al. (2020) introduced wav2vec 2.0, which learns contextualized acoustic representations from raw unlabeled audio and can then be fine-tuned with limited transcribed speech. HuBERT improved masked prediction with cluster-based targets ( Hsu et al., 2021 ) , and XLS-R scaled the wav2vec 2.0 recipe to nearly half a million hours of multilingual audio across 128 languages ( Babu et al., 2021 ) . Large multilingual speech resources such as FLEURS ( Conneau et al., 2022 ) , Common Voice ( Ardila et al., 2020 ) , VoxPopuli ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , and MMS ( Pratap et al., 2023 ) have further strengthened multilingual transfer.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的语音学习已成为低资源ASR的主要范例. Baevski等 (2020年)引入了wav2vec 2.0,从生来无标签的音频中学习出上下文化的声学表达,然后可以用有限的转录语音来进行微调. HuBERT改进了基于集群目标的蒙面预测(Hsu等,2021年),而XLS-R将wav2vec 2.0食谱缩放到128种语言的近50万小时多语种音频(Babu等,2021年). FLEURS(Conneau等,2022年),Common Voice(Ardila等,2020年),VoxPopuli(Wang等,2021年),MMS(Pratap等,2023年)等大型多语言语音资源进一步加强了多语言传入.

blocks.en: 2.2 Code-switched ASR and synthetic data
blocks.zh: 2.2 密码交换ASR和合成数据

blocks.en: A recent systematic review of end-to-end CS-ASR studies notes that, although data augmentation is widely used, it remains less explored than many model-centric approaches ( Agro et al., 2025 ) . In response, recent studies have used synthetic text and speech to improve low-resource code-switched ASR. Several works explore how synthetic code-switched data can be created or leveraged when real code-switched speech is scarce. Nguyen and Tran (2025b) show that ASR systems can be trained with synthetic phrase-level code-switching derived from monolingual resources, while Nguyen and Tran (2025a) propose AsyncSwitch, which adapts models on large amounts of code-switched text before aligning this knowledge with limited paired speech. More broadly, Hamed et al. (2025) find that the value of synthetic code-switched data depends strongly on its quality and the downstream task. At the same time, recent work has introduced stronger benchmarks and architectures for code-switched ASR. Yan et al. (2025) present CS-FLEURS, a multilingual benchmark covering 113 unique code-switched language pairs, and show that synthetic training data improves performance on both seen and unseen pairs. Ugan et al. (2024) show that bilingual ASR systems still struggle on realistic code-switching benchmarks, while Ye et al. (2024) propose a mixture-of-experts architecture to better handle language switching in streaming and non-streaming settings. Earlier work also explored semi-supervised and unified approaches ( Tazakka et al., 2024 ; Dhawan et al., 2023 ) . Overall, these works show that synthetic data is becoming an important tool for code-switched ASR, especially in low-resource settings where real code-switched speech is scarce. They also suggest that the main challenge is not only generating more data, but generating data that is linguistically and acoustically useful for adaptation.
blocks.zh: 最近对端到端的CS-ASR研究进行的系统审查指出,虽然数据增强被广泛使用,但与许多以模型为中心的方法(Agro等人,2025年)相比,其探索仍然较少。 作为回应,最近的研究利用了合成文本和语音来改进低资源码开关的ASR. 一些作品探索了在真实的代码切换语音稀缺时,合成代码切换数据如何创建或被杠杆化. Nguyen和Tran(2025b)显示,ASR系统可以通过由单一语言资源衍生的合成词组级代码切换来进行训练,而Nguyen和Tran(2025a)则提出AsyncSwitch,后者在将这一知识与有限的对等语音相配合之前,先在大量代码切换文本上修改模型. 更广泛地说,Hamed等人(2025年)发现,合成密码开关数据的价值在很大程度上取决于其质量和下游任务. 同时,最近的工作为密码开关ASR引入了更强大的基准和架构. 颜等. (2025年)目前CS-FLEURS是一个多语种基准,涵盖113个独特的代码切换语言对,并显示合成培训数据既能改善所见和所见对的性能. Ugan等 (2024年) 显示双语ASR系统仍在为现实的代码切换基准而挣扎,而Ye等. (2024)提议采用专家混合结构,以更好地处理流式和非流式环境中的语言切换. 早先的工作还探讨了半监督和统一的办法(Tazakka等,2024;Dhawan等,2023)。 总体而言,这些作品表明合成数据正成为代码开关ASR的一个重要工具,特别是在资源低的环境下,真正的代码开关语音很少. 它们还表明,主要的挑战不仅在于生成更多的数据,而且在于生成在语言和声学上对适应有用的数据。

blocks.en: 2.3 Meta-learning for ASR
blocks.zh: 2.3 ASR的元学习

blocks.en:
Meta-learning is well suited to low-resource ASR because it explicitly learns parameters that can adapt quickly to new conditions with limited supervision. Early work applied MAML-style meta-learning to end-to-end ASR, learning
initializations from high-resource languages that adapt quickly to
low-resource targets ( Hsu et al., 2020 ) , and Winata et al. (2020) extended this idea to code-switched speech with meta-transfer learning,
which draws episodes from monolingual corpora so that the initialization
transfers to limited real CS data. Our work differs in that episodes are
sampled from synthetic CS speech of the same language pair and the
meta-learner is first-order Reptile rather than MAML. Recent ASR work has strengthened this direction: Meta-Adapter shows that meta-initialized adapters improve self-supervised speech adaptation for low-resource languages ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , SMILE extends meta-learning to few-shot multilingual ASR through speech meta in-context learning ( Hsu and Lee, 2024 ) , and MetaMixSpeech shows that task augmentation can improve generalization in multilingual low-resource ASR ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Together, these studies motivate meta-learning as an effective framework for fast speech adaptation under severe data scarcity.
Related ideas also appear in multilingual NLP, where targeted adaptation has been shown to improve transfer to low-resource language families ( Downey et al., 2024 ) . In code-switched ASR, recent work such as AsyncSwitch emphasizes adaptation to limited paired code-switched speech after prior exposure to code-switched resources ( Nguyen and Tran, 2025a ) .

跨模型、参数计数、预训历史、标识和解码机制
不同之处。 因此,跨模型实验研究了Reptile的好处是否在建筑环境之间延伸;模型之间的绝对差异不能仅仅归因于建筑.

blocks.en: 3.2 Source tasks: CS-FLEURS data
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 资料来源:CS-FLEURS数据。

blocks.en:
Our synthetic source data are drawn from CS-FLEURS ( Yan et al., 2025 ) , a corpus of synthetic code-switched speech spanning multiple language pairs. We use four code-switched subsets from XTTS version as it contains training data for our meta learning experiments: Hindi-English (6 hours), French-English (10.28h), Arabic-English (4.51 hours)
and German-English (9.37 hours), where each subset corresponds to one language pair and the reported durations denote the total amount of synthetic training audio available for that pair. For a model a a and target pair p p , synthetic episodes are sampled only from the corresponding source subset S p S_{p} . Thus, each meta-training run learns a model-specific,
pair-specific initialization rather than an initialization
trained jointly across language pairs.
blocks.zh:
我们的合成源数据取自CS-FLEURS(Yan等,2025年),这是一系列跨越多种语言对口的合成密码切换语. 我们使用XTTS版本的4个代码切换子集,因为它包含我们元学习实验的训练数据:印地语-英语(6小时),法语-英语(10.28小时),阿拉伯语-英语(4.51小时)
和德-英(9.37小时),每个子集对应一种语言对等,报告的持续时间表示该对对等的合成训练音频的总量. 对于一个型号 a 和目标配对 p , 合成片段只取自相应的源子集 S p s_{p}. 因此,每次元培训都学习一种模式,
成对特定初始化而不是初始化
联合培训跨语言对等。

blocks.en: 3.3 Target tasks: MUCS and Switchlingua data
blocks.zh: 3.3 目标任务:MUCS和Switchlingua数据

blocks.en:
We evaluate adaptation under real-world code-switched conditions using all four pairs as target tasks. Real-world Hindi-English speech data is from MUCS ( Diwan et al., 2021 ) , French-English (2.64 hours), Arabic-English (1.43 hours) and German-English (1.40 hours) are from the SwitchLingua dataset ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . SwitchLingua provides real audio recordings from bilingual
speakers, but the spoken prompts are generated code-switched text samples. Thus, the target audio is human speech, while the linguistic content follows a synthetic-script collection protocol. Unlike SwitchLingua, MUCS Hindi-English is extracted from human spoken tutorials. The speech is therefore real
instructional audio, and the code-switching primarily arises from technical lecture content rather than from generated code-switched text. For each target pair, we randomly select a 1-hour labeled subset for adaptation and evaluate final performance on the corresponding real code-switched test set. As CS speech data is scarce, this setup is intentionally low-resource and is designed to measure how effectively a model trained on synthetic code-switched speech can transfer to real speech with only a small amount of target-domain supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们评价在现实世界代码交换条件下的适应,将所有四对作为目标任务. 真实世界的印地语-英语语音数据出自MUCS(Diwan等,2021年),法语-英语(2.64小时),阿拉伯语-英语(1.43小时)和德语-英语(1.40小时)出自SwitchLingua数据集(Xie等,2025年). SwitchLingua提供双语录音
扬声器,但语音提示是生成代码切换文本样本。 因此,目标音频是人语,而语言内容遵循合成-标语集协议. 与SwitchLingua不同的是,MUCS 印地语-英语是从人类口语教程中提取出来的. 因此,演讲是真实的
教学音频,而代码开关主要来自技术讲座内容,而不是生成的代码开关文本. 对于每一对目标,我们随机选择一个1小时被标注的子集进行适应,并在相应的真实代码切换测试集上评价最终性能. 由于CS语音数据稀缺,这种设置是故意的低资源,旨在测量一个接受过合成密码开关语音训练的模型在只有少量目标域监督的情况下,能怎样有效地转移到真实语音.

blocks.en: 3.4 Metrics and Text normalization
blocks.zh: 3.4 计量和文本正常化

blocks.en: We report Word Error Rate (WER) and Character Error Rate (CER) using Levenshtein edit distance ( Levenshtein, 1966 ) : WER \displaystyle\mathrm{WER} = S + D + I N w , \displaystyle=\frac{S+D+I}{N_{w}}, (3) CER \displaystyle\mathrm{CER} = S c + D c + I c N c . \displaystyle=\frac{S_{c}+D_{c}+I_{c}}{N_{c}}. The same normalization is applied to references and hypotheses for all systems before scoring: unicode normalization, removal of markup artifacts, punctuation stripping, whitespace normalization, and case normalization for Latin-script text. We do not introduce system-specific post-processing. For Arabic-English, the evaluation uses the same common normalization pipeline and does not apply additional Arabic-specific orthographic collapsing unless explicitly configured in the released scoring script. WER and CER are standard and comparable across all four pairs; we complement them with a description of the code-switching profile of each test set. Multi-reference WER ( Ali et al., 2015 ) and PolyWER ( Kadaoui et al., 2024 ) are not used here because MUCS and SwitchLingua provide a single reference per utterance; constructing alternative references manually would introduce subjective normalization choices.

WER和CER在所有四个对中都是标准且可比较的;我们用每个测试集代码切换剖面描述来补充它们. 多参考WER(Ali等,2015年)和PolyWER(Kadaoui等,2024年)在此不使用,因为MUCS和SwitchLingua每句提供单一参考;人工构建替代参考将引入主观正常化选择.

blocks.en: 4.1 Why First-Order Meta-Learning?
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 为什么第一命令的Meta学习?

blocks.en: Reptile is particularly suitable for our setting because it avoids differentiating through the inner optimization trajectory ( Nichol et al., 2018 ) . In MAML, after k k inner updates θ τ ′ = U τ k ​ ( θ ) \theta^{\prime}_{\tau}=U_{\tau}^{k}(\theta) , the meta-update requires θ ← θ − β ​ ∇ θ ℒ τ out ​ ( U τ k ​ ( θ ) ) , \theta\leftarrow\theta-\beta\nabla_{\theta}\mathcal{L}^{\mathrm{out}}_{\tau}\left(U_{\tau}^{k}(\theta)\right), and therefore backpropagates through the sequence of inner-loop optimization steps. In its standard form, this introduces second-order derivatives and substantial memory and computational overhead. This overhead is particularly relevant when repeatedly adapting large pretrained speech models, including CTC, transducer, encoder–decoder, and Speech-LLM systems. Reptile instead uses the parameter displacement θ ← θ + β ⁡ ( θ τ ′ − θ ) , \theta\leftarrow\theta+\beta(\theta^{\prime}_{\tau}-\theta), without differentiating through the trajectory that produced θ τ ′ \theta^{\prime}_{\tau} . The outer update can therefore be applied across our four architectural settings while the inner loop uses each model’s transcription objective. Our hypothesis is that repeated adaptation on synthetic CS episodes produces an initialization that transfers more effectively to limited real target speech than ordinary synthetic-domain fine-tuning. This hypothesis is tested through within-model comparisons against CFT. Reptile’s first-order formulation reduces the derivative overhead associated with standard second-order MAML, but does not remove the cost of repeated inner-loop training.
5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Baselines and Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 5.1 基线和可复制性

blocks.en:
For each model a a and language pair p p , we compare four
training regimes: • Synthetic-only transfer: train from the model’s pretrained checkpoint on S p S_{p} and evaluate directly on E p E_{p} , without real adaptation. • Real-only fine-tuning: fine-tunes the pretrained model on A p A_{p} only. • Continual fine-tuning (CFT): train first on S p S_{p} and then adapt on A p A_{p} . • SyRA-CS: learn a Reptile initialization from episodes sampled
from S p S_{p} , then adapt on A p A_{p} . Within each model–pair combination, all regimes start
from the same pretrained checkpoint. Methods using real
adaptation share the same one-hour subset, and all methods
are evaluated on the same held-out set. Trainable parameter scope, tokenization, transcript normalization, and inference settings are fixed across regimes within each model. CFT is the closest baseline because it uses the same
synthetic source set and real target subset as SyRA-CS.
Their comparison tests the value of episodic Reptile
training relative to ordinary sequential training.

for each model.

blocks.en: The encoder–CTC model benefits most: macro WER falls from 0.4740 to 0.3900 (17.7%) and macro CER from 0.1885 to 0.1590 (15.6%). The largest pair-level gains are on Arabic-English (WER 0.615 → \rightarrow 0.461) and German-English (0.432 → \rightarrow 0.333). XLS-R also has the weakest CFT baseline of the four models, leaving the most room for improvement.
blocks.zh: 编码器-CTC模型的效益最大:宏观WER从0.4740降至0.3900(17.7%),宏观CER从0.1885降至0.1590(15.6%). 最大的一对级收益是阿拉伯语-英语(WER 0.615 →\右翼0.461)和德语-英语(0.432 →\右翼0.333)。 XLS-R也有四种型号中CFT基线最弱,为改进留下了最广阔的空间.

blocks.en: Nemotron 3.5 and Audex-2B improve both metrics on every pair, with macro WER/CER reductions of 5.3%/4.4% and 5.8%/7.5%, respectively. Audex gains most on Arabic-English (WER 0.577 → \rightarrow 0.539) and Hindi-English (0.520 → \rightarrow 0.490). Whisper-small improves WER on every pair (5.5% macro) and macro CER by 8.3%, driven mainly by Hindi-English (CER 0.418 → \rightarrow 0.349). Its Arabic-English result is the only regression: WER decreases slightly (0.352 → \rightarrow 0.348) while CER increases (0.162 → \rightarrow 0.181), so pair-level conclusions can depend on the metric.
blocks.zh: Nemotron 3.5和Audex-2B每对都改进了两个度量衡,宏观WER/CER分别减少5.3%/4.4%和5.8%/7.5%. 奥德克斯在阿拉伯语-英语(WER 0.577 → 右翼0.539)和印地语-英语(0.520 → 右翼0.490)上收获最多. Whisper-small在每对(5.5%的宏)和宏观CER上改进了WER,提高了8.3%,主要由印地语-英语驱动(CER 0.418 →\rightarrow 0.349)。 它的阿拉伯语-英语结果是唯一的回归:WER稍有减少(0.352 →\正线0.348)而CER增加(0.162 →\正线0.181),因此对等级的结论可以依赖于度量.

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows pair-level relative reductions against CFT. WER reductions range from 5.4% to 25.0% for XLS-R, 1.6% to 9.7% for Nemotron, 1.1% to 10.5% for Whisper, and 3.3% to 6.6% for Audex. All four models improve both WER and CER on Hindi-English, French-English, and German-English. On Hindi-English, WER improves by 13.2%, 1.6%, 6.4%, and 5.8% for XLS-R, Nemotron, Whisper, and Audex, respectively. Because Hindi-English differs from the SwitchLingua pairs in corpus, domain, and switching density (Section 5.3 ) simultaneously, these results cannot isolate switching density as a driver of the gains.
blocks.zh: 图2显示相对CFT的对等水平削减。 XLS-R的WER减少从5.4%到25.0%,Nemotron减少从1.6%到9.7%,Whisper减少从1.1%到10.5%,Audex减少从3.3%到6.6%。 所有四种型号都改进了印地语-英语,法语-英语和德语-英语上的WER和CER. 在印地语-英语上,WER分别改进了13.2%,1.6%,6.4%和5.8%的XLS-R,Nemotron,Whisper,和Audex. 由于印地语-英语与SwitchLingua的对子在体,域,和切换密度(第5.3节)同时存在差异,这些结果不能孤立切换密度作为收益的驱动力.

blocks.en: Synthetic-only transfer yields the highest error in 28 of 32 cells, confirming a substantial synthetic-to-real gap. CFT outperforms real-only fine-tuning in 29 of 32 cells (exceptions: Whisper German-English WER, a tie on Whisper German-English CER, and Audex Arabic-English CER), making it a strong baseline. Real-only XLS-R nearly fails on Hindi-English (WER 0.980), which inflates its macro score, so we treat CFT as the primary comparison. Because CFT and SyRA-CS use the same synthetic subset and the same one-hour real subset, their gap reflects the training strategy rather than additional data.
blocks.zh: 在32个细胞中的28个细胞中,只有合成-转录产生出最高出错,证实了一个巨大的合成-现实差距. CFT在32个细胞中的29个细胞(例外:Whisper German-English WER,Whisper German-English CER上的平分,和Audex 阿拉伯语-English CER)中表现优于实际的微调,使其成为了强大的基线. 真实的XLS-R在印地语-英语(WER 0.980)上几乎失败了,这夸大了它的宏观分数,所以我们把CFT作为主比较. 由于CFT和SyRA-CS使用相同的合成子集和相同的一小时真实子集,它们的缺口反映了训练策略而不是额外数据.

blocks.en:
German-English and Arabic-English contain only 1.40 and 1.43 hours of real speech before the one-hour adaptation split, leaving 104 and 218 test utterances. To assess dependence on these sets, we recompute the CFT–SyRA-CS macro comparison after excluding German-English and then after excluding both pairs (Figure 6 ). Without German-English, relative macro WER reductions are 16.2% for XLS-R, 4.3% for Nemotron, 4.6% for Whisper, and 5.9% for Audex, with CER reductions of 13.8%, 3.9%, 8.0%, and 8.2%. Retaining only Hindi-English and French-English, WER reductions are 9.8%, 3.5%, 6.3%, and 5.3%, and CER reductions are 8.9%, 3.9%, 14.5%, and 8.7%. All four models therefore keep positive macro gains on both metrics in every subset. XLS-R’s gain shrinks as its two strongest pairs are removed, whereas Whisper’s CER gain grows once its Arabic-English regression is excluded.
These exclusions are descriptive sensitivity checks, not significance tests. All averages weight pairs equally; pooled error rates and paired uncertainty estimates require utterance-level edit statistics, and variability across training seeds and adaptation subsets is not assessed here.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
The results support the central hypothesis: synthetic CS speech is more effective when used to learn an adaptation-friendly initialization than when used only through ordinary sequential fine-tuning. This is shown by the consistent SyRA-CS improvements over CFT, the closest matched baseline. The largest Reptile benefit appears where the pretrained model is furthest from a usable CS recognizer. XLS-R is pretrained only with self-supervision and its CTC head is learned from scratch, so the initialization carries the most weight: real-only fine-tuning nearly fails on Hindi-English (WER 0.980), and SyRA-CS yields the largest gain (17.7% macro WER). Nemotron, Whisper, and Audex already have supervised ASR pretraining, start from stronger CFT baselines, and gain less (5.3–5.8%). This suggests that a meta-learned initialization matters most when the backbone lacks task-specific supervision, although a single model per architecture prevents a causal claim. Whisper’s Arabic-English result does not contradict this picture. Its WER improves while its CER worsens, a pattern that indicates character-level edits within otherwise correctly recognized
words rather than additional word errors; this is the signature of Arabic orthographic variation that our shared, script-agnostic normalization does not
collapse. We therefore read the regression as a normalization artifact rather than a failure of the initialization. Practically, SyRA-CS uses no data beyond what CFT uses, making it a low-cost alternative under a one-hour real-data budget, provided the additional meta-training compute is acceptable.

XLS-R只通过自导自演进行预训,其CTC头部从零开始学习,因此初始化携带了最重的重量:真实的微调在印地语-英语(WER 0.980)上几乎失败了,而SyRA-CS得到的最大收益(17.7%的宏WER). 内莫特龙、怀斯克和奥德克斯已经监督了ASR的预训,从更强的CFT基线开始,收益更少(5.3–5.8 % ) 。 这表明,元学习初始化在骨干缺乏具体任务监督的情况下最为重要,尽管每个架构有一个单一的模式可以防止因果索赔。 华声的阿拉伯语-英语结果与这张照片并不矛盾. 它的WER在它的CER恶化时会改进,这种模式显示字符级编辑在被正确识别的范围内

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SyRA-CS, a pair-specific Reptile framework for synthetic-to-real CS ASR adaptation. Across four pretrained models spanning encoder–CTC, FastConformer–RNN-T, AED, and Speech-LLM architectures, and with the same synthetic source data and one-hour real adaptation budget within each model, SyRA-CS lowers WER relative to continual fine-tuning in all 16 model–pair comparisons and CER in 15, with relative macro WER reductions of 5.3% to 17.7%. Gains are largest for XLS-R, smaller but consistent for the other three models, and remain positive when the two smallest evaluation sets are excluded. These results are consistent with the intended role of Reptile: learning a lightweight initialization that specializes readily to real CS speech. Future work will add compute-matched controls, multi-seed significance testing, CS diagnostics for all models, additional language pairs and more spontaneous speech corpora.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SyRA-CS,这是合成到现实CS ASR的一对特异性框架. SyRA-CS通过四个预先训练的模型,跨越了编码器 — — CTC、FastConformer — RNN-T、AED和Speech-LLM架构,并且在每个模型中拥有相同的合成源数据和一小时的实际适应预算,比起所有16个模型的连续微调(Pair comparating)和15个CER,WER的相对宏观削减率为5.3%至17.7%。 XLS-R的得分最大,较小,但与其他三种模式一致,在排除两套最小评价时保持正数. 这些结果与Reptile的预期作用是一致的:学习一种轻量级的初始化,这种初始化可以随时用于真正的CS语音. 未来的工作将增加计算相配的控制,多种子意义测试,所有模型的CS诊断,额外的语言对接和更自发的语音Corpora.

We evaluate SyRA-CS using fixed synthetic-source datasets and a one-hour labeled real adaptation budget, without systematically varying either data volume. The experiments therefore do not establish the minimum amount of synthetic or real speech needed to achieve a given level of recognition accuracy, nor how these two data sources trade off during adaptation.
Controlled data-scaling experiments are needed to
characterize these requirements and identify diminishing returns from additional data.
